answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 2677 Country: India Title: My issue is that i have some intestinal problem (constipation). Thus whenever i offer prayer i feel i have done "hahath" but i never use to be sure. It happens to me in every prayer. Sometimes i control hadath. Please tell me what should i do,as i cannot offer any prayer with 100% concentration. Question: My issue is that i have some intestinal problem (constipation). Thus whenever i offer prayer i feel i have done "hahath" but i never use to be sure. It happens to me in every prayer. Sometimes i control hadath. Please tell me what should i do,as i cannot offer any prayer with 100% concentration. Answer ID: 2677 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 61/61=L) Keep on praying salah until you are sure of passing wind, only doubt does not invalidate the wuzu : عن ابی ھریرۃ رضی اللہ عنہ قال: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: اذا وجد احدکم فی بطنہ شیئاً فاشکل علیہ ا خرج منہ شئ ام لا فلایخرجن من المسجد حتی یسمع صوتا او یجد ریحاً (مشکاۃ : 1/40 ) و فی حاشیتہ او یجد ریحاً ای یجد رائحۃ ریح خرجت منہ و ھذا مجاز عن تیقن الحدث لانھما سبب العلم بذلک، کذا قال علماؤنا ۔ ( ibid ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
